_comment: Slice 1A (this commit): config in place, no calibration thresholds.
Initial run produces a baseline; thresholds get set in slice 1B.
Until calibrated, the gate cannot fail-the-build (no `break` threshold) —
it produces the score for inspection only.
Allowlist follows ADR-0017 §2 exactly. Excluded paths (jxa/omnijs scripts,
adapter, prompts, *.data.ts) are not in the mutate glob and are also
explicitly listed in the issue body's exclusion notes.
_thresholds_pending_calibration: Slice 1B captures the baseline run output and writes thresholds here. Until then, no `thresholds.break` is set so the gate is informational only.
